query: WITH weekly AS (SELECT person_id,toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Seoul'),1) AS week FROM events WHERE timestamp>=toDateTime('2026-08-03 00:00:00','Asia/Seoul') AND timestamp<toDateTime('2026-10-26 00:00:00','Asia/Seoul') AND event IN ('offer_link_click','banner_click') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM raw_cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=464290 AND version=54) AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM static_cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=500325) GROUP BY person_id,week) SELECT a.week,count() AS users,countIf(b.person_id=a.person_id) AS returned FROM weekly a LEFT JOIN weekly b ON a.person_id=b.person_id AND b.week=a.week+INTERVAL 4 WEEK WHERE a.week<=toDate('2026-09-21') GROUP BY a.week ORDER BY a.week
